column2: Ascension — take everyone
Rupture — protect
Seed — awaken
Requires 4 Sleepers awakened along the way
Let's go home. All of us.
(The Kenoma begins to come apart, like a dream at dawn. She looks back once.)
No one will be abandoned again. I'll stay. I'll watch over everyone.
(The throne is still warm. It fits.)
I won't climb. I won't sit. I'll go down and knock on every door.
(Far below, in the ashes where she woke, someone begins to stir.)
ASCENSION
Each spark returned to the Source. The Kenoma faded like dreams at dawn.\nThe whole truth. No world at all.
RUPTURE
Sophia sat on the still-warm throne. The crown fit.\nNo one would be abandoned again. No one would ever leave.
SEED
Sophia refused throne and door. She went back down, spark by spark.\nNo apocalypse and no prison: a slow freedom, the only kind that lasts.
Sleeper
I was dreaming of my mother. Why did you wake me?
Sleeper
It's cold out here. Was it always?
How long did I sleep? ...No. Don't tell me.
Thank you. I think.
Were you asleep too? You have the look.
If I wake up, who looks after my dream?
He said sleeping was a kindness. Who said? I can't remember who said it.
Leave the light on. Just for a little while.
I remember a woman who sang off-key. Ina? Did you know Ina?
My son is sleeping two streets over. Will you go there too? Please?
It hurts. Why does waking hurt?
Because it's yours.
I dreamed I could fly. Down here everything weighs so much.
I didn't ask for this. ...But now that I see, I don't want to close my eyes.
They talk of a woman who walks among the sleepers. Was that you?
The ashes are still warm. Walk: the mist waits for no one.
(A stone with writing, just ahead. Someone left words for whoever woke.)
Everything here is too big. Like a child's room seen from the floor.
(The floor is made of gears. They turn slowly, as if breathing.)
The echoes have the Archons' faces. But they move like him.
I'm putting myself back together from the inside out. Almost there.
The shards don't come back warm. They come back cold. And true.
He called the Rings a key. Keys open, and he forgot they open both ways.
The echoes don't scream when they fall. They weep.
They sleep standing up. No one here knows the city is gone.
You see? Those who sleep do not suffer. Those who wake do. But only those who wake climb.
The stone spoke of a Silence before everything. Why does that sound like a memory?
Do not trust the stones too much. Whoever wrote them is not here to explain.
Pairs of light. Aeons. Then who was my pair?
No one climbs in pairs, Bearer. One climbs alone. With me.
Athoth's Champion guards the shrine. Wake him with blows.
If the Pleroma is so full, why does no one come down for those who sleep?
Because the Light above does not look down. I do.
Do you feel the mist? It is Athoth's breath. It wants you to lie down.
The antechamber. Behind it, the first throne. Do not lie down. Never lie down.
A throne in a dream-room. And he hasn't even opened his eyes.
The smell of bread everywhere. No one eats. Everyone chews.
Matter hungers for everything that shines. And you shine. Careful.
They call this world the Kenoma, the void. But it's full to the brim.
Full of lack. That is what ‘void’ means.
The stone says the Blind One was born without pair or form. Who leaves a child like that alone?
Those above. They call it patience.
The Glutton guarding the shrine eats what it kills. Do not die near it.
You know my name. Why do you never tell me yours?
A name, here, becomes a collar. Call me what you always have: Voice.
Someone in white up ahead, standing in a light that comes from nowhere.
They say one Soter wanders these parts. I have never seen him.
Harmas's antechamber. Blows first; talk, never.
A whole market in his belly. And he still looks at me hungry.
Seals everywhere. Every door has a padlock; every padlock, a name.
Heimarmene, the ancients said: Fate as a chain. Here, it truly is a chain.
The stars are the links. Seven links, seven heavens, seven Archons.
And you have broken two already. Go on.
Galila does not hate you. He classifies you. That is worse.
The shrine's Jailer binds first and asks later. Dodge, and the chain snaps.
If the law here is fear wearing a crown, who wears the crown?
The Blind One, high above. No one else. Climb.
The stone says the breath in the clay came from outside this world. So did I?
You came from me. I found you. Do not forget the order of things.
Last door before the throne. His chains sing when they are afraid.
A throne made of links. He chained himself so he wouldn't fall.
Blank books. Thousands. Someone erased an entire library.
Here the Word was silenced. Yabel sewed his own mouth shut to set the example.
Did you hear that? Again. Faint, underneath you.
An echo. This Aeon is full of them. Ignore it.
Here spells fall silent. Trust the staff: it has no need to speak.
The shrine's Librarian silences everything around him. Keep away and strike fast.
The stone tells of books buried in a jar, found by chance. Truth survives buried.
It survives. That is not the same as winning.
If remembering is knowing, I want to remember. Even what hurts.
Remembering has its hour. Now is the hour to climb.
I did not fall silent from fear. I do not speak to those who do not fight, that is all.
The antechamber of Silence. In there, not even I speak.
He won't speak. And I'll have to answer anyway.
Still water everywhere. And in every puddle, me.
Do you know the story? Wisdom saw her own face in the water and went down after it.
Vanity. Do not repeat it.
The name on the stone is mine. Sophia.
A common name. Wisdom. Half the mothers in the Kenoma give it to their daughters.
Astaphaios will give you what you want most: you, before everything. The cruelest blow.
The shrine's Reflection backs away when you strike. Strike where it will be.
The stone says it wasn't her face in the water. It was a false light, seen from above.
Stones repeat whatever they like. Water is water. Climb.
She repented thirteen times, and sang. I haven't sung a single one.
Last room before the great glass. Do not look at yourself more than you must.
He has my face. The Voice says it's a trick. The Voice says a lot of things.
Swamp. The sparks sink slowly, like candles.
Matter rots. It is the one law the Blind One did not write, and the one that frightens him.
The stone says the Kingdom is inside and outside. Inside this swamp?
Inside you. Outside of here. Climb.
Belias does not lie. He is tired, and he thinks tiredness is the truth.
The shrine's Spore-Bearer poisons even after death. Kill it and step away.
Five Rings. Two more, and I will show you the end of all this.
A prince went down to fetch a pearl and forgot who he was. Until a letter reminded him.
Lovely. No one sent you any letter. You have me.
The last rotten antechamber. After it, the Crown. Hold on.
He's been dying for ages. He just won't let anyone finish.
A throne on every corner. All empty. All waiting for someone to sit.
The last step. Armupiel nearly touched the Blind One's throne. ‘Nearly’ defines him.
The stone speaks of a Call: a voice from outside that wakes sleepers. Is that how you found me?
It is. I called; you heard. That is all that matters.
Here the servants kneel even to die. Do not grow used to seeing people on their knees.
